newsitem.title: ITALY: Salomon Bros maintains buy on Italy's TIM.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Bros maintains buy on Italy's TIM.

text.p: Shares in Italian mobile phone operator TIM Telecom Italia Mobile have apppreciated by 15-16 percent this year, but Salomon Brothers said the company continues to trade at the "most attractive multiples" and maintained its Buy recommendation with a target price of 5,100 lire.
TIM, which operates the biggest cellular network in Europe, closed on Monday off 1.16 percent at 4,441 lire on a weaker Milan stock market.

"Despite being the first year with meaningful competition from Omnitel, 1996 was another banner year for TIM. The company added 1.84 million new users for a total of 5.7 million cellular subscribers," Salomon said in a report.
"The catalyst for TIM's high growth in 1996 was a continued buoyant Italian cellular market that added 4.3 percentage points to its penetration rate for a year-end rate of 11 percent," Salomon said.
